products.name: Kumkumadi Soap
products.shortDescription: Ayurvedic Kumkumadi oil with saffron and sandalwood to brighten and nourish.
products.description: Our signature bar, made in small batches around Kumkumadi oil, a traditional Ayurvedic blend prized for radiance. Saffron and sandalwood give it a warm, golden character, and the rich lather cleanses without leaving skin tight. A daily ritual for skin that looks brighter and feels nourished.
products.howToUse: Wet the soap and your skin, work up a soft lather between your hands, massage gently and rinse with lukewarm water. Keep the bar on a draining soap dish between uses so it lasts longer.

products.name: Dahlia Herbal Face Soap
products.shortDescription: A gentle herbal bar for sensitive skin and everyday face care.
products.description: Made for the delicate skin of your face. This soft, low-lather herbal bar cleanses gently, so it suits sensitive skin that reacts to harsher soaps. Skin is left clean, calm and comfortable.
products.howToUse: Lather between your hands, massage the foam gently over damp face avoiding the eye area, then rinse well. Use morning and night.

products.name: Vanilla Herbal Soap
products.shortDescription: Nourishes dry skin and leaves it feeling refreshed.
products.description: A comforting herbal bar for dry skin. Creamy plant oils help nourish while you cleanse, and the soft vanilla note comes from natural ingredients, never synthetic fragrance. Skin feels refreshed, never stripped.
products.howToUse: Wet the soap and your skin, work up a soft lather between your hands, massage gently and rinse with lukewarm water. Keep the bar on a draining soap dish between uses so it lasts longer.

products.name: Coffee Cream Soap
products.shortDescription: Real coffee grounds gently exfoliate, with a fresh coffee aroma.
products.description: Your morning coffee, made for the shower. Fine coffee grounds buff away dull, rough skin while a creamy base keeps it soft. The natural aroma of fresh coffee wakes you up without any fake scent.
products.howToUse: Lather on damp skin and massage in small circles to let the coffee grounds exfoliate, then rinse. Best on the body; use gently 2–3 times a week on rough areas.

products.name: Haldi Chandan Moisturizer
products.shortDescription: Turmeric and sandalwood for deep nourishment and a natural glow.
products.description: Haldi (turmeric) and chandan (sandalwood) are the heart of traditional Indian skincare. Our body moisturizer brings them together in a rich cream that nourishes deeply and leaves skin with a healthy, natural glow.
products.howToUse: Smooth a small amount over clean, slightly damp skin, ideally after your bath or shower. Massage in upward strokes until absorbed. Use daily, morning or night.

products.description: All the radiance of our Kumkumadi ritual in a lightweight body moisturizer. Kumkumadi oil and saffron hydrate without heaviness and help skin look luminous. It absorbs quickly, so you can dress straight away.
products.howToUse: Smooth a small amount over clean, slightly damp skin, ideally after your bath or shower. Massage in upward strokes until absorbed. Use daily, morning or night.

products.name: Coffee & Vanilla Moisturizer

products.name: Herbal Oil
products.shortDescription: A calming body oil that hydrates and soothes.
products.description: A calming blend of herbs infused in nourishing plant oils. Massaged into skin after bathing, it hydrates, soothes and turns your routine into a few quiet minutes for yourself.
products.howToUse: Warm a few drops between your palms and massage into damp skin after bathing, focusing on dry areas such as elbows, knees and heels. A little goes a long way.

products.name: Mango Butter Lip Balm
products.shortDescription: Keeps lips soft, hydrated and protected.
products.description: Rich mango butter in a smooth balm that keeps lips soft and hydrated, and helps protect them from the dry UAE air and air-conditioning.
products.howToUse: Glide over clean lips whenever they feel dry. Apply a thicker layer before bed for overnight softness.
